summary: Results-driven Product Designer with 8+ years of experience in user-centered design for digital products, specializing in fintech and vendor management applications. Proven ability to translate complex requirements into intuitive user flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity prototypes, designing over 170 screens across key functionalities. Expertise in user research, design systems, and accessibility, with a Google UX Design Professional Certificate. Seeking to leverage design skills to enhance user experiences and drive product innovation.

bullets: Spearheaded the design of 3 digital products for mobile and web platforms, partnering with product design and research teams to translate user needs and business requirements into intuitive product experiences.
Crafted 70+ screens and 8 significant user flows encompassing inventory management, order processing, payments, messaging, and analytics.

Contributed to quantitative research involving 25 Nigerian vendors, identifying significant friction in payment and refund tracking for 72.7% of respondents and fragmented staff communication for 63.6%.

Transformed vendor research insights into product design priorities, with the research matrix indicating that over 81% of respondents expressed immediate demand for an all-in-one vendor management application.
Developed wireframes, high-fidelity interfaces, and interactive prototypes to effectively communicate design decisions and support the product development lifecycle.
Instituted reusable UI components and design patterns to ensure visual consistency across all product interfaces.
Applied user-centered design and accessibility principles to support vendors with diverse levels of digital literacy.
Engineered 100+ screens across 12 key user flows for fintech product experiences, including payments, transactions, personal finance, dependent accounts, and group savings.
Designed the Dependent Accounts experience, encompassing dependent linking, identity verification, and spending-limit configuration.
Conceptualized 'Ajoo,' a group-savings feature built around recurring contributions and coordinated participant commitments.
Translated intricate financial requirements into clear user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity UI designs, and interactive prototypes.
Established reusable UI components and design patterns to foster consistency across product screens and workflows.
Collaborated with stakeholders and technical teams to align interface decisions with business objectives, functional requirements, and implementation constraints.
Produced over 4000 digital and print campaign assets, including social media creatives, promotional materials, event flyers, and large-format banners.

Developed brand identities, product packaging, and corporate collateral for diverse clients across Nigeria, the United Kingdom, and Ireland, notably Teejay African Munch, EO Afrobeat, and C.I. Asonye Ltd.
Acquired over 4 years of agency experience at Huesdek, advancing from Design Apprentice to Graphic Designer and overseeing projects from initial concept through to final production.
Partnered with international founders and business owners to translate marketing objectives into cohesive visual assets across digital, print, and physical touchpoints.

education.institution: Michael Okpara University of Agriculture Umudike
